display.purpose: Page titles and the home headline.

frame-script.purpose: Customer text inside frames only; never interface text.

shadows.name: hang
shadows.purpose: Frames hanging on a wall, light from the top-left.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Wall colour changes (450ms) and frame resizing on the wall (400ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on every page: Create your frame.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2346d8; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1b37b0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 70 216 / .55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: WhatsApp Order Button
components.css: .ds-btn-wa { background: #128c4a; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-wa:hover { background: #0e7a40; } .ds-btn-wa:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 70 216 / .55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Tile
components.description: Size and finish pickers with the price underneath.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; font: 500 .92rem Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111827; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-choice small { display: block; color: #6b7280; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: #cfd3da; } .ds-choice[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: #2346d8; background: #eef2ff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2346d8; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 500 .9rem Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #4b5563; } .ds-field input { font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 13px; min-height: 46px; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2346d8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(35 70 216 / .18); }

components.name: Wall Chips
components.description: Switches every wall on the site; remembered across pages.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-chip { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb, 0 2px 6px rgb(17 24 39 / .15); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #111827, 0 2px 6px rgb(17 24 39 / .15); }

components.name: Hung Frame on Wall
components.description: Signature: a frame on a nail and picture wire over a textured wall.
components.css: .ds-wall { position: relative; background: #8fd3b6; border-radius: 20px; height: 260px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-dado { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 18%; background: #6fbf9e; } .ds-hung { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 110px; filter: drop-shadow(10px 18px 14px rgb(12 28 22 / .32)); margin-top: 30px; } .ds-nail { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 30px); width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-left: -4.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3a3a38; } .ds-wire { position: absolute; left: 12%; width: 76%; bottom: 100%; height: 34px; } .ds-frame { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; background: #fbfbf9; border: 10px solid #1c1c1c; }

narrative.northStar: The frame belongs on a wall
narrative.overview: A clean modern gift store with one dramatic idea: every frame is shown hanging on a wall, in the visitor's wall colour, and the customizer hangs the customer's own design at true scale above a sofa.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, one accent, one sans (Onest)
Textured distemper walls with a dado band
Nail, picture wire and soft offset shadow on every frame

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks action and selection only; walls carry the colour.

rules.name: Admin owns the brand
rules.body: Accent, hover, tint and background come from /admin; never hard-code them.

dos: Show every frame hanging on a wall
Keep WhatsApp green for ordering only
donts: No eyebrows, gradient text or glyph icons
No sample testimonials presented as real
No walls used as decoration behind text
